The Chinese characters for George

As a transliteration, George is usually written 乔治 (Qiáo zhì). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

乔
Qiáo
tall, lofty
治
zhì
govern, cure

Origin and meaning

George comes from Greek and means “farmer, earth-worker”.

About the name George

The name of six British kings and of George Washington, the first US president.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, George carries the meaning “farmer, earth-worker” and looks striking in brush strokes.
